label: Sentry
description: Sentry DSNs, organization tokens, and user tokens.

signals.reason: A DSN only sends error events. It is public in the browser, and it cannot read data.
An organization token (sntrys_) creates releases and uploads source maps. It cannot read events.
A user token (sntryu_) has the scopes that the user selected, so Apassy does not suggest the scope.
The item name or a label names Sentry.
A host of the item is a Sentry host.
